Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chakradhari Sharan
 Singh
 and
 Honourable Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar Verma

(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHAKRADHARI SHARAN  SINGH)
11 19-01-2023 The appellant has put to challenge the judgment and order dated 30.03.2017/03.04.2017 passed by the Trial Court whereby, after having been convicted of the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, he has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life.

Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
mandates expeditious hearing of the appeals arising out of conviction under Sections 376, 376(A),
376(AB), 376(B), 376(C), 376(D), 376(DA), 376(DB) or 376 (E) of the Indian Penal Code.
The said provision further requires that such appeal should be disposed of within a period of six months from the Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.532 of 2017(11) dt.19-01-2023 date of filing of such appeal.

In such view of the matter, instead of considering the appellant's prayer for his release on bail during the pendency of the appeal, it is considered desirable, keeping in mind the statutory prescription envisioned under Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to expedite hearing of the appeal itself.
List this appeal for hearing on 23.02.2023 at 02:15 p.m..
